The carapace is high-domed, oval, and dark brown/black with a smooth but slightly dirty surface. The head is visible on the left side, showing a pointed snout and small eye. One front limb is visible, appearing stout with webbing. The plastron is mostly obscured by the ground and angle.

The connection between the front-left limb and the body/shell is somewhat indistinct. The limb seems to emerge from the shadow without a clear anatomical joint definition, blending slightly into the dark shell edge.
